_readme: Single source of truth for all site content. href values written as '@name' or '@social.name' resolve against Assets/juma-tutu-links.json at build time. Run `node build/generate.mjs` after editing.

site.name: Swahili Jazz
site.title: Swahili Jazz | Timeless Culture. Unforgettable Experiences.
site.description: A Kenyan entertainment company built on live music. Swahili Jazz performs, produces events, manages artists and runs its own record label.
site._noindex: Set false at launch. While true the build emits noindex/nofollow and a disallow-all robots.txt so client-review deploys never reach search results.

paragraphs: Swahili Jazz is a Kenyan entertainment company built on live music. We produce events, manage artists, run a record label and advise on entertainment. You will find us at corporate functions, festivals, diplomatic events, hotels, private celebrations and cultural productions. Every booking gets the same care, whatever the size of the room.

The company was founded by Juma Tutu, a saxophonist, composer, music director and cultural ambassador. Decades of playing and long-standing partnerships sit behind everything we do. The Government of Kenya named Juma a National Hero for his contribution to the country's music, arts and cultural heritage.

Our slogan is “The Sounds of the Soul,” and it shapes how we work. Music brings people together. We look after the artists coming up behind us, and we give audiences in Kenya and abroad a night worth remembering.
